title: Rectangular prism
spec: Create a new coordinate system with the Euler angles set to zero degrees and the translation vector also set to zero. Next, draw a two-dimensional sketch on the first face. In the first loop, start by drawing the first line from the coordinates (0.0, 0.0078) to (0.0322, 0.0078). Continue by drawing the second line from (0.0322, 0.0078) to (0.0434, 0.0), followed by the third line from (0.0434, 0.0) to (0.1277, 0.0). Draw the fourth line from (0.1277, 0.0) to (0.1277, 0.0012), then the fifth line from (0.1277, 0.0012) to (0.0438, 0.0012). Proceed with the sixth line from (0.0438, 0.0012) to (0.0326, 0.009), and the seventh line from (0.0326, 0.009) to (0.0, 0.009). Finally, draw the eighth line from (0.0, 0.009) back to (0.0, 0.0078) to complete the loop. After completing the sketch, apply a scale factor of 0.1277 to the entire two-dimensional sketch. Transform the scaled sketch into three dimensions by rotating it with the Euler angles set to zero degrees and translating it with the translation vector set to zero. To generate the three-dimensional model, extrude the two-dimensional sketch 0.75 units in the positive normal direction without extruding in the opposite direction. This operation will create a new solid body named the rectangular prism. The final dimensions of the rectangular prism are a length of 0.12769262634631315 units, a width of 0.009009942004971001 units, and a height of 0.75 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the sketch
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0078) \
     .lineTo(0.0322, 0.0078) \
     .lineTo(0.0434, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.1277, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.1277, 0.0012) \
     .lineTo(0.0438, 0.0012) \
     .lineTo(0.0326, 0.009) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.009) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0078) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch
r = r.extrude(0.75)

# The final model is represented as 'r'

lanes.label: GLM-5.3 Flash (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Sheet with a joggle (offset step) along its length
# Thickness of the sheet: 0.005
# Total Y offset (joggle rise): 0.004  -> overall Y = 0.009
# Joggle located near the left end in X

t = 0.005      # sheet thickness
rise = 0.004   # joggle offset
jx1 = 0.018    # start of joggle transition
jx2 = 0.022    # end of joggle transition
L = 0.1277     # total length in X
H = 0.75       # height in Z

profile = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(0.0, 0.0)
    .lineTo(jx1, 0.0)
    .lineTo(jx2, rise)
    .lineTo(L, rise)
    .lineTo(L, rise + t)
    .lineTo(jx2, rise + t)
    .lineTo(jx1, t)
    .lineTo(0.0, t)
    .close()
)

r = profile.extrude(H)

lanes.label: Kimi K3 (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

X = 0.1277
Y = 0.0090
Z = 0.7500

t = 0.0015
x1 = 0.0200
x2 = x1 + (Y - t)

pts = [
    (0.0, Y),
    (x1, Y),
    (x2, t),
    (X, t),
    (X, 0.0),
    (x2, 0.0),
    (x1, Y - t),
    (0.0, Y - t),
]

r = cq.Workplane("XY").polyline(pts).close().extrude(Z)
